notes.title: Lite Version
notes.notes:
The new version of the game in which you have an unlimited number of attempts to pass the level, in the lite version you are not limited to lives, which makes the passage much easier

To enable the lite version, you need to go to the properties, then to the beta-version and select the lite mode
